provenance.steps: Pool MTG_FIX|EUR|2024-02-29. L1: A = 100,000 - 1,000 = 99,000, PARTIAL 2,000. L2: A = 50,000 - 500 + 10,000 = 59,500 (the drawdown counts as exposure), PARTIAL 5,000. L3: A = 20,000 - 200 = 19,800, FULL 19,800. L4: final scheduled repayment, MATURITY with A = 0. L5: A = 80,000 - 800 = 79,200 (the negative other_change -1,000 does not reduce A), NONE. L7: MATURITY with a prepayment of 400 in the maturity month, so A = 1,000 - 600 = 400 > 0; MATURITY enters neither sum whatever A is. Valid NONE, PARTIAL and FULL rows always have A > 0, so the exclusion of A <= 0 is observable only on a zero-residual RENEG (RATE-POOL-02, M6). Sum A = 257,500; sum P = 26,800 = 7,000 PARTIAL + 19,800 FULL, over 4 loan-months. SMM = 26,800 / 257,500; the mean of the four loan SMMs, (2/99 + 10/119 + 1 + 0) / 4 = 13,009 / 47,124, is a different number. L6 is in USD and forms its own pool: A = 9,900, P = 990.
